subject: [PATCH v9 20/32] mm/hmm: fault PMD swap entries on demand

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the handling of absent PMD entries in the Linux kernel's Heterogeneous Memory Management (HMM) module. Specifically, it treats swapped-out huge pages as non-resident memory rather than a permanent failure, similar to how PTE swap entries are handled. This change is made by adding a check for swap entries and returning them as not valid when no fault was requested.
